name: Robertson Quay
summary: Riverfront dining and apartment living — social evenings with CBD adjacency.
body:
Robertson Quay is River Valley’s more restaurant-forward face: riverside tables, apartment towers, and a weekend crowd that spills from lunch into evening. Ideal for people who want walkable dinners and a short Grab to the CBD. Less ideal if you need quiet bedrooms facing the promenade or large outdoor play space for toddlers.

Great World station on the Thomson-East Coast Line and Fort Canning on the Downtown Line cover most trips, with the CBD a short ride away. School buses serve the towers well, which matters more than the MRT for families. Ask which side of the block faces the promenade before signing; weekend noise is stack-specific.
commuteNotes: Fort Canning / Great World; riverwalk toward Clarke Quay.
